dct_description_sm: This dataset contains GPS RINEX 2.11 format files for GPS observations made by the test vehicle, a text file containing the reference trajectory of the test vehicle, and a series of video frames spanning the same time period as the GPS data and the reference trajectory described in the paper: Tightly-Coupled GNSS/Vision using a Sky-pointing Camera for Vehicle Navigation in Urban Areas, published in Sensors, doi:10.3390/s18041244
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Tightly-Coupled GNSS/Vision using a Sky-pointing Camera for Vehicle Navigation in Urban Areas
